title: जिस बालक से देवता डरे | रामायण भाग 11
topic: Vishvamitra answers Rama's question about the river of three paths by first telling Uma's story: Rudra and Uma wed and dwell as one for a hundred divine years with no son; the gods, fearing a child of such power, beg Rudra to hold his energy within; the Earth receives what has stirred, Agni and Vayu enter it and it becomes the white mountain and the reed forest; Uma, denied a son, curses the gods and the Earth; Rudra and Uma go to Himavan for tapas (Valmiki Ramayana 1.36.1–27; teaser 1.36.27)
edition: vulgate (southern recension), sa.wikisource; verse numbers cross-checked on valmikiramayan.net (Internet Archive copy)

sources.note: Rama and Lakshmana praise the tale and ask the sage to tell the elder daughter's story in full: by what cause does the purifier of the worlds flood three paths, and by what deeds is she renowned in the three worlds? (pays off the Ep10 card 'Three Paths')
asked thus, Vishvamitra told the whole tale among the sages: long ago, Rama, the blue-throated great ascetic (शितिकण्ठः) had married (कृतोद्वाहः)
the union of the god and the Devi; a hundred divine years passed (दिव्यं वर्षशतं गतम्); narrated only as 'dwelt as one for a hundred years of the gods'
yet no son was born to her (न चापि तनयो… आसीत्); all the gods, led by Brahma (पितामहपुरोगमाः), were stirred to act
'whatever being is born here, who will withstand it?' (कस्तत् प्रतिसहिष्यति); the gods approached and bowed
O god of gods, devoted to the good of this world, be gracious; the worlds cannot bear your power (न लोका धारयिष्यन्ति तव तेजः); with Brahmic austerity, do tapas with the Devi
for the good of the three worlds hold your power within your power (तेजस्तेजसि धारय); protect all these worlds, do not unmake them (verse card)
the great lord of all worlds said 'so be it' (बाढम्): I will hold my power within, together with Uma; let the gods and the Earth be at peace
but who will bear this unsurpassed power of mine that has already stirred from its place (क्षुभितं स्थानात्)? Tell me
the gods replied: the power that has stirred today, the Earth (धरा) will bear it
he released it, and the Earth with her mountains and forests (सगिरिकानना) was pervaded by that power
then the gods told Agni: joined with Vayu (वायुसमन्वितः), enter this great power of Rudra
pervaded again by Agni, it became the white mountain (श्वेतपर्वतम्) and a divine reed forest (दिव्यं शरवणम्) like fire and the sun
where Kartikeya, born of Agni, was born; the gods and sages worshipped Uma and Shiva, glad at heart (not narrated: Kartikeya's birth belongs to sarga 37)
then the mountain's daughter, in anger (समन्युः), eyes red with wrath, cursed them all: since I was stopped when I longed for a son (पुत्रकाम्यया)…
…you shall beget no offspring in your own wives; from today let your wives be childless (अप्रजाः सन्तु पत्नयः)
having said this to all the gods she cursed the Earth too: O Earth, you will take many forms (नैकरूपा) and be the wife of many (बहुभार्या)
sullied by my anger, you will not know the joy of sons (पुत्रकृतां प्रीतिम्), since you did not want my son
seeing all the gods afflicted, the lord of the gods set out toward the quarter guarded by Varuna (the west)
having gone there, the great lord did tapas with the Devi on the northern side of that mountain, on a peak arising from Himavat (हिमवत्प्रभवे शृङ्गे)
this, Rama, is the full account of the mountain's daughter; now, with Lakshmana, hear from me the Ganga's origin (गङ्गायाः प्रभवं… शृणु) (teaser verse)
while the god did tapas, the gods with Indra, led by Agni, seeking a commander (सेनापतिमभीप्सन्तः), went to Brahma (Next card only, not narrated)

learnings.how: Applied. The stakes are in the first sentence (the gods feared a child not yet born, 1.36.7–8), and the turn, the verse card where the gods beg Rudra to hold his power within for the three worlds (1.36.11), starts at about 16.5 s. The episode uses the 55 s two-beat shape, whose T1 window is 24–33 s; the card comes early by design, near the 18–25 s window A1 names, so the stakes rise before the 13 s drop-off. The 35 s shape is not used: sarga 36 carries the marriage, the gods' fear, the plea, the Earth, Agni and Vayu, the white mountain, two curses and Rudra's tapas, this script is at about 51.49 s by lint.

Applied. The hook is 2.45 s, under the 3.0 s limit, with the stake in the first sentence, written natively short in each language (gu: દેવો અજન્મા બાળકથી ડરતા હતા.; te: పుట్టని బిడ్డకు దేవతలు జడిశారు.). The en hook is 2.74 s, inside the 2.5–2.8 s Kokoro-safe band. Frame 0 is the night summit with Rudra's silhouette and the dimmed orbs of the gods, which the engine draws at least 70% by frame 0 (O5).

Partly applied. The density of sarga 36 needs the 55 s shape, so the lower half of 35–55 s is not reachable without dropping beats the owner listed. Every language was cut to the owner's 50–53 s target instead: this script is 51.49 s by lint (Ep10 rendered hi 55.9 s and gu 55.83 s; this episode's hi and gu lint estimates are about 2 s below Ep10's).

Applied on screen. Scene 10 carries the share prompt 'अग्नि और वायु ने क्या रचा?' (6 words or fewer) as its title card. It is answered in the text in scene 8 (1.36.17–18): the white mountain and the reed forest. It replaces the first draft's prompt after review F3, which could invite anatomical replies. It is not spoken, because no language has seconds to spare. The same line is suggested as the pinned comment so shares/reach can be compared with Ep10.
